# Fetch all spotify library playlists (paginated) and compute which songs need removal/addition

all_playlists = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20

while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page_index', page_index, 'page_len', len(page) if page is not None else None)
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('total_playlists', len(all_playlists))

# Find archived playlist if exists
archived_title = 'Archived Playlist Songs'
archived_candidates = [p for p in all_playlists if p.get('title') == archived_title]
print('archived_candidates_count', len(archived_candidates))
if archived_candidates:
    print('archived_candidate_playlist_ids', [p.get('playlist_id') for p in archived_candidates])

# Compute intersections
removals = []  # list of (playlist_id, song_id)
removal_playlist_ids = set()
songs_to_archive = set()

for p in all_playlists:
    pid = p.get('playlist_id')
    song_ids = p.get('song_ids') or []
    inter = set(song_ids) & target_song_ids
    if inter:
        for sid in inter:
            removals.append((pid, sid))
        removal_playlist_ids.add(pid)
        songs_to_archive |= inter

print('affected_playlists_count', len(removal_playlist_ids))
print('removals_count', len(removals))
print('songs_to_archive_count', len(songs_to_archive))
print('songs_to_archive_sample', sorted(list(songs_to_archive))[:50])

# Print a brief per-playlist intersection sample for verification
sample = []
for pid in list(removal_playlist_ids)[:5]:

    inter = set(p.get('song_ids') or []) & target_song_ids

print('sample_affected', sample)

# Execute Spotify operations: create archive playlist, add songs, remove from old playlists

archived_playlist_title = 'Archived Playlist Songs'

# 1) Create playlist (only if not already present)
# Use previously computed archived_candidates_count==0 from earlier code block if available; otherwise re-check quickly from all_playlists variable.
if 'all_playlists' not in globals():
    raise Exception('Expected all_playlists variable from earlier computation')

archived_candidates = [p for p in all_playlists if p.get('title') == archived_playlist_title]
print('archived_candidates_count_pre', len(archived_candidates))

if archived_candidates:
    archived_playlist_id = archived_candidates[0].get('playlist_id')
    print('Using existing archived_playlist_id', archived_playlist_id)
else:
    create_res = apis.spotify.create_playlist(title=archived_playlist_title, access_token=spotify_token)
    print('create_playlist_response', create_res)
    archived_playlist_id = create_res.get('playlist_id')

print('archived_playlist_id', archived_playlist_id)

# 2) Add all target songs to archive playlist
songs_to_archive_sorted = sorted(list(songs_to_archive))
print('songs_to_archive_sorted_count', len(songs_to_archive_sorted))

added_song_ids = []
for sid in songs_to_archive_sorted:
    res = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=archived_playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
    added_song_ids.append(sid)

print('added_song_ids_count', len(added_song_ids))

# 3) Remove target songs from every playlist where they appear
removed_pairs = []
for pid, sid in removals:
    apis.spotify.remove_song_from_playlist(playlist_id=pid, song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
    removed_pairs.append((pid, sid))

print('removed_pairs_count', len(removed_pairs))

# Keep variables for verification
removed_playlist_ids = sorted(list(removal_playlist_ids))
print('removed_playlist_ids_count', len(removed_playlist_ids))
print('removed_playlist_ids_sample', removed_playlist_ids[:10])

# Verification pass (single set)

ver_playlists = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 50
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('verify_show_playlist_library_page_index', page_index, 'len', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    ver_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('verify_total_playlists', len(ver_playlists))

# Build lookup playlist_id -> song_ids and title
playlist_song_ids_map = {}
playlist_title_map = {}
for p in ver_playlists:
    playlist_song_ids_map[p.get('playlist_id')] = set(p.get('song_ids') or [])
    playlist_title_map[p.get('playlist_id')] = p.get('title')

# Verify archive playlist contents
archive_song_ids_after = playlist_song_ids_map.get(archived_playlist_id)
print('archive_song_ids_after_exists', archive_song_ids_after is not None)
print('archive_song_ids_after_count', len(archive_song_ids_after) if archive_song_ids_after is not None else None)
print('target_song_ids_count', len(target_song_ids))
print('archive_missing_count', len((target_song_ids - (archive_song_ids_after or set()))))
print('archive_extra_count', len(((archive_song_ids_after or set()) - target_song_ids)))

# Verify each affected playlist has zero target songs
failures = []
for pid in removal_playlist_ids:
    after_set = playlist_song_ids_map.get(pid, set())
    inter_after = after_set & target_song_ids
    if inter_after:
        failures.append((pid, playlist_title_map.get(pid), sorted(list(inter_after))))

print('verification_failures_count', len(failures))
if failures:
    print('verification_failures_sample', failures[:5])

# Store for completion
verify_ok = (len(failures) == 0 and archive_song_ids_after is not None and (archive_song_ids_after == target_song_ids))
print('verify_ok', verify_ok)
